name: YINSON
recent: Yinson 近期出现多项 TAKE-OVERS & MERGERS (Paragraph/Rule 9.19(47A)) 公告，同时 EPF 与 KWAP 等主要股东持续申报持股变动。公司也披露了董事及高管在闭市期外的 RSU 股份交易。
notable: 公司多次发布 TAKE-OVERS & MERGERS (Paragraph/Rule 9.19(47A)) 公告。
主要股东 EPF 与 KWAP 在多个交易日申报持股变动。
集团执行主席、集团首席执行官等高管因 2026 RSU 获得普通股。
risks: 主要股东 EPF 与 KWAP 的持股变动需留意后续披露。
董事及高管在闭市期外进行股份交易。

recent_en: Yinson has recently issued multiple TAKE-OVERS & MERGERS (Paragraph/Rule 9.19(47A)) announcements, while major shareholders such as EPF and KWAP have continued to report changes in their shareholdings. The company also disclosed RSU share dealings by directors and senior management outside the closed period.
notable_en: The company issued multiple TAKE-OVERS & MERGERS (Paragraph/Rule 9.19(47A)) announcements.
Major shareholders EPF and KWAP reported changes in their shareholdings on several trading days.
Senior executives including the Group Executive Chairman and Group Chief Executive Officer received ordinary shares under the 2026 RSU.
risks_en: Changes in shareholdings by major shareholders EPF and KWAP warrant attention to subsequent disclosures.
Directors and senior management conducted share dealings outside the closed period.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 July 2026, revenue was MYR 1,136,000,000, up 8.3% QoQ and down 16.7% YoY; net income was MYR 128,000,000, up 6.7% QoQ and up 26.7% YoY; net margin was 11.3% versus 11.4% in the prior quarter.
